notes.decision: Give today one quiet focal point
notes.did: Put the nearest task inside the pale green today panel.
notes.why: A personal task manager should make the next deadline easy to find.
notes.traded: The deadline appears twice: in priorities and today.
notes.instead: A productivity chart would add an unsupported metric.

notes.decision: Keep task totals in one band
notes.did: Group incomplete, upcoming and completed task counts in one summary.
notes.why: The priority list deserves more attention than the totals.
notes.traded: Each count has less independent emphasis.
notes.instead: Three separate metric cards would add borders and consume space.
